WITH large AS (
  SELECT k_symbol, amount
  FROM `order`
  WHERE amount > 2802
),
per AS (
  SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM large
  GROUP BY k_symbol
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall
  FROM per
)
SELECT p.k_symbol,
       p.avg_amount,
       p.avg_amount - o.overall AS excess
FROM per p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall
ORDER BY excess DESC;
